question: A man covers half part of a certain distance at 45 km/hr. He covers 40 percent of remaining distance at the speed of 8 km/hr and covers rest of the distance at the speed of 24 km/hr. What is his average speed for the entire journey?
solution:

Speed for the first half of the distance = 45 km/hr.

Speed for 40% of the remaining distance = 8 km/hr.

Speed for the rest of the distance = 24 km/hr.

Average speed = Total distance travelled / Total Time
